workload.deletion_granularity_reason: ODXT registers a deletion only under the s-term and assumes document-level deletion (NDSS'21 III-C fn.3). Per-pair deletion would make it return stale matches -- a strawman in our favour.
workload.language: rust-vs-rust on one host; no Python figure appears here
workload.query_set: fixed across tiers: drawn once from the smallest tier, whose documents every tier contains
workload.sdsse_bloom: h = 5, p = 1e-4 (their 5.1); each keyword's filter sized for its own deletions, floor 10: kinder than the authors' one d for all (Require-Consultant 1cu.2)
workload.sdsse_first_and_repeat: each first search is timed and rolled back outside the timed region; the repeat is timed after one kept first search
workload.tiers: nested: one seeded permutation of the corpus, tier N its first N files (corpus::load_nested)
